name: ClientSideUiComposition
summary: Builds one screen from UI components rendered by several service-specific front ends, composed on the client.

roles.name: UiComponent
roles.summary: The participant rendering one region, owned by the team behind its service. Composed in the browser rather than on the server, so a failure degrades one region instead of the response.

roles.name: PageSkeleton
roles.summary: The skeleton the components are placed into. It decides layout and nothing else, and it is the participant that must keep working when a component does not arrive.
